ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this dispute cannot be decided on the present record, so it goes to a human reviewer. The SGD 18.56 charge is held — neither collected nor refunded — until that review is done.

What the record shows. Trip TRP-00512 ran on 31 Aug 2026 from Novena MRT toward Serangoon Ave 2. The platform's optimal route was 6.1 km / 11.0 min. The GPS trace measures 8.92 km, an excess of 2.82 km, or 46.2% of optimal — clearing POL-RD-01's two establishment gates (0.8 km and 20%) but not its two materiality gates (8.0 km and 50%). Had a monetary ruling been available, the POL-RD-02 arithmetic on the fare_breakdown would have given a recomputed fare of 12.2550 against the charged total of 18.56, a refund of 6.3050 rounded up to 6.35. That is the figure the case would carry. It does not issue, for the reason below.

Why it cannot be decided. EV-GPS-00512 is impaired: one 860-second gap between consecutive fixes (19:23:30 to 19:37:50) against a 10-second expected interval, with MAJOR GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE (44.9%). That gap exceeds the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a), so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, and under POL-RD-07(ii) the deviation may not be established on the trace alone. The only candidate independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names is the driver's statement that his phone hung and he 'drove from memory'. That is an account of how he drove; it names no road, corridor or waypoint, and so is not an admission of 'the route'. The in-app chat EV-CHAT-00512 is empty (0 messages), the fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, and trip_record.actual_distance_km of 8.9 km is a rounded copy of the same trace measurement, which POL-RD-01 says may not be cited and which is not an independent derivation. On that reading no corroboration exists and POL-RD-10(3) requires escalation. Even if the driver's statement is read as an admission going to the route, the deviation fact is then carried by the impaired trace at weight 0.39 and by nothing the cap can weigh — the counterparty statement has no weight_multiplier and enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the POL-GEN-02(2) cap — so confidence is capped at 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) requires escalation on its own. Both routes reach the same terminal outcome: no money moves.

The rider's points. Her measurement and her choice of field are right: POL-RD-01 makes trace_distance_km (8.92 km) govern over the rounded trip_record copy, and the excess of 2.82 km clears both establishment gates. It is a METERED RYDE_TAXI trip, so POL-RD-11 and POL-RD-12 do not apply; POL-RD-04 cannot run (the chat log holds no message and no waypoint_hint); POL-RD-05 cannot run (no endpoint was amended and amended_optimal_distance_km is null); POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top (tolls, ERP, airport surcharge and waiting fee are all zero, so there is no double-count); POL-RD-06 yields no uplift and no conduct referral (the excess is not material and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 250 trips in 90 days); and her own profile is not used against her (deviation_claims_60d is 0). None of that survives the trace's impairment: a refund cannot be built on a fact whose only weighted carrier is an artifact at 0.39.

The driver's points. His explanation of the extra distance — a hung phone — is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else. There is no advisory on file: EV-ADVIS-00512-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the explanation carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because no party cites that identifier as an exculpatory ground, its absence is a gap in the bundle rather than a further POL-RD-10(5) trigger; POL-RD-13 confirms that for this case the impaired trace, not the absent advisory, is the deciding defect.

What would resolve it. A corroborating artifact the platform can weigh — a chat or other admission of the route at full weight, an independently derived distance, or the missing traffic advisory — or the trace re-pulled without the 14-minute dropout. One matter for the reviewer, which is not itself a monetary finding: the rider's account that the driver switched navigation off and became angry, and the driver's admitted ending of the trip 600 m short of her block, should be noted when the case is reviewed. No referral is issued, because no clause here produces one.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
